## Validation

## Conflict-resolution record

- [ ] Remote state was fetched before editing and before pushing.
- [ ] Concurrent work was preserved; no destructive operation or history rewrite was used.
- [ ] Conflicts, if any, were resolved semantically using the merge base, both sides, 3–10 relevant commits, tests, contracts, linked work, and related repositories.
- [ ] Compatible intent from both sides was preserved; any discarded intent is documented.
- [ ] The complete worktree was scanned for unresolved conflict markers.

## Final checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and respects repository ownership boundaries.
- [ ] Documentation, tests, and generated artifacts reflect the final contract.
- [ ] External Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs.
- [ ] Workflows declare least-privilege permissions, timeouts, and concurrency where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, sensitive logs, or private-repository inventory are included.
- [ ] The exact proposed head and authoritative remote state were verified.
